title: Kept valid Router decisions authoritative at runtime
points: Valid narrative plans are no longer replaced by ROIC screens merely because query wording resembles a ranking request.
Valid model-build plans are no longer deleted when users describe a forward operating model with wording outside a runtime regex list.
Empty explicit model requests now recover directly into a complete typed model plan without a whole-plan LLM corrective retry.
Router traces now expose the complete final plan, and collision evals assert that structurally valid plans cross runtime unchanged.
ROIC answers that overstate a requested horizon now receive one traced Analyst retry using the supplied usable-period evidence instead of a runtime text rewrite.
